evidence.V1: Front, three-quarter and silhouette all read instantly as a picket fence panel with a capped post; even the top view shows post, rail and picket rhythm.
evidence.V2: Clear tiers: big (post + panel), medium (pointed pickets, two rails, post cap), small (ink nail heads on alternate pickets, cap chamfer band).
evidence.V3: Confident stylisation: chunky pointed pickets with slight height variation, oversized capped post and protruding rail stubs give a cartoon read rather than stiff primitives.
evidence.V4: Close_rails and close_post_cap studio show consistent chamfers on picket points, picket edges, rail ends and the post cap that catch highlight lines.
evidence.V5: Studio and flat close-ups clean: no pinches, seams, z-fighting or stray facets at the rail ends or picket points; rails seat behind pickets; A17/A18 pass.
evidence.V6: One wood hue in three values (light pickets, mid rails, dark post) plus ink nails; walnut and crimson colourways keep the same value structure.
evidence.V8: Single LF_VertexColor material, wood hue for a fence per wave-2 spec, kit-range chamfers, ink iron nails; reads as the same kit as the anchor barrel.
evidence.V9: Studio line: Anchored, Box collision, CanTouch off, MeshPart white + SmoothPlastic, grid-corner pivot; T1 tiling passes (contain mode, cover 1.0).

top_fixes: Nail every picket (not only alternates) for consistent small-scale detail
Provide an end-post variant so the bare rail stubs on the open end are not left unsupported at the end of a run
Optional: a slight lean or tonal variation per picket to push the hand-made feel
